item.title: BCSO Drug Unit Seize 17 Guns During Recent Drug Arrest | Brunswick County Sheriff's Office
item.description: Two Shallotte men were recently arrested on drug charges following a several month long investigation. Antwan Damitri King, 39, of Tolson Circle, Shallotte, was arrested on 11/16/18 and charged with PWIMSD cocaine, maintaining a dwelling used for keeping and selling controlled substance, possession of drug paraphernalia, and possession of a fire arm by a felon.
